title: VersaTiles map (.mapjson), format version 1
description: A map of the VersaTiles map editor: its visible area, properties and elements. See https://github.com/versatiles-org/versatiles-map-editor/blob/main/packages/map-state/MAPJSON.md

frame.description: What a shared or embedded map shows when it opens, and how its viewers can turn it.

elements.description: The elements, in drawing order: the first one at the back, the last one in front.

$schema.description: The URL of the JSON Schema of the format version of the file, `MAPJSON_SCHEMA_URL`.

MapJSON.description: The content of a .mapjson file: a map state with the URL of its schema.

bounds.description: The visible area: what the map shows completely, whatever the size and the shape of the window. Without it, the bounds of the elements are shown.

bearing.description: The rotation of the map: the compass direction at the top of the window, in degrees clockwise from north, e.g. 90 with east at the top. Default: 0, north at the top.

pitch.description: The tilt of the map, in degrees: 0 looks straight down, more looks towards the horizon. Default: 0.

canPan.description: Viewers can move the map. Default: true.

canZoom.description: Viewers can zoom in and out. Default: true.

canRotate.description: Viewers can rotate the map. Default: false.

canTilt.description: Viewers can tilt the map. Default: false.

confine.description: Viewers stay in the area that the map shows when it opens: they cannot zoom out further, nor move the map beyond it. Default: false.

StateFrame.description: What a shared or embedded map shows when it opens: an area, seen from a direction, and what its viewers can do from there: move it and zoom, unless that is switched off; rotate and tilt it, if that is switched on.

Bounds.description: A geographic area: west, south, east and north, in degrees (WGS 84).

background.description: The background map. Without it, the map has the editor's default background.

legend.description: A legend, defined by the author, not generated from the elements.

colorScheme.description: The id of the color scheme offered for the map's colors. Without it, the default scheme.

viewer.description: What a shared or embedded map shows over it, and where: the search, the zoom buttons, the legend.

labels.description: How the labels are shown: those of markers, and those of the background map.

title.description: The title of the map, e.g. for the list of maps, the title of the page and file names.

base.description: The vector map of OpenStreetMap, or satellite imagery.

theme.description: The theme of the vector map, one of `@versatiles/style`, e.g. "gray" or "gray-dark".

streets.description: Whether the satellite map shows streets, railways and the symbols of points of interest over the imagery. The vector map always does.

borders.description: Whether the satellite map shows the borders of countries and states over the imagery. The vector map always does.

labels.description: How many labels the map shows: all, fewer (with more space between them), or none.

language.description: The language of the labels: "user" (of the browser), "local" (the local names), or a language code, e.g. "de".

font.description: The glyph font of the labels.

labelSize.description: The size of the labels, as a factor.

haloWidth.description: The width of the halo around the labels, in pixels. Default: 2 on the vector map, 1 over the imagery.

colors.description: Changes of the colors of the map.

hillshade.description: The relief shaded: hills and mountains with light and shadow.

terrain.description: The terrain raised to its heights, which a tilted map shows.

buildings.description: The buildings of the vector map: "flat", or "extruded" to their heights, which a tilted map shows when zoomed in.

options.description: Options of `@versatiles/style` for what the settings cannot say, e.g. `{ "features": { "terrain": { "exaggeration": 2 } } }`: of `osm()` for the vector map, of `satellite()` for the imagery. They are laid over the options that the editor builds from the settings, so they win where both say something. The editor does not write them itself.

StateBackground.description: The background map, as its author set it: the base map, its theme, its labels, its colors and its relief. The editor builds the map from these settings, with `@versatiles/style`. Missing fields have their default; the background with only defaults is not stored at all.

black.description: The lightness that black becomes, where 0 is black and 1 white.

StateBackgroundColors.description: Changes of the colors of the background map; without them, its colors are as they are.

layout.description: How the entries are arranged. "inline" flows like text. Default: "vertical".

bold.description: The texts of all entries in bold. Default: false.

italic.description: The texts of all entries in italic. Default: false.

theme.description: The background and the border of the legend. Default: "light".

StateLegendEntry.description: A row of the legend: a small copy of an element, and a text. Its styles are those of an element of its kind, with the same defaults (see the elements).

StateLegendMarker.description: A legend entry with a marker.

symbol.description: The image of the symbol, e.g. "icons:anchor", or "" for none. Default: a flag.

color.description: The color of the symbol, with its opacity.

size.description: The size of the symbol, as a factor.

rotation.description: The rotation of the symbol, in whole degrees clockwise.

haloWidth.description: The width of the halo around the symbol and the label, in pixels.

haloColor.description: The color of the halo around the symbol and the label.

labelColor.description: The color of the text of the label.

labelSize.description: The size of the label, as a factor of 16 pixels.

font.description: The glyph font of the label, e.g. "noto_sans_bold"; "" for the font of the labels of the background map.

labelPosition.description: The position of the label around the symbol; "auto" where it fits, or on the point without a symbol.

flat.description: The marker lies flat on the map, its symbol and its label: on a map that is rotated or tilted, it turns and tilts with the map, so e.g. an arrow keeps its compass direction, and the positions of the label are compass directions. Else it stands upright and faces the viewer, however the map is turned.

MarkerStyle.description: The style of a marker: its symbol, and the look of its label. Missing fields have their default.

HexColor.description: A color as hex code: "#rrggbb", or "#rrggbbaa" with its opacity (alpha). Written in lower case.

StateLegendLine.description: A legend entry with a line.

color.description: The color of the line, with its opacity.

dash.description: Solid, dashed, dotted, long dashes, or dashes and dots.

arrowStart.description: The arrowhead at the first point.

arrowEnd.description: The arrowhead at the last point.

arrowSize.description: The width of the arrowheads across the line, as a factor of the width of the line. Only with an arrowhead.

LineStyle.description: The style of a line: its color, width and dashes, and its arrowheads. Missing fields have their default.

StateLegendArea.description: A legend entry with an area, e.g. of a polygon or a circle.

color.description: The color of the area, with its opacity.

patternScale.description: The size of the pattern, as a factor; at 1 the lines (across them) or the dots are 8 pixels apart. Only with a pattern.

patternCoverage.description: The share of the area that the lines or dots of the pattern cover, from 0.05 to 0.95. Only with a pattern.

AreaStyle.description: The style of an area (of a polygon or a circle): its color and pattern. Missing fields have their default.

color.description: The color of the outline, with its opacity.

dash.description: Solid, dashed, dotted, long dashes, or dashes and dots.

OutlineStyle.description: The style of the outline of an area. Missing fields have their default.

navigation.description: The buttons for zooming in and out. Default: "top-right".

legend.description: The legend, if the map has one: a side (centered) or a corner. Default: "bottom-left".

reset.description: A button that shows the map as it opened: its area, its rotation and its tilt. With the buttons for zooming, or where they would be. Default: false.

StateViewer.description: What the viewer shows over the map, and where: a control at a position, or "none"; a button (e.g. `reset`) with the buttons for zooming, or not. Controls in the same corner are stacked. Defaults in `VIEWER_DEFAULTS`.

overlap.description: Labels of markers that would overlap other labels: "show" them all, also on top of each other, or "hide" them (their symbols stay).

minZoom.description: The zoom level from which the labels of markers are shown, with one decimal place, above 0 and up to 24, e.g. 12.5. Without it, at every zoom level.

mapOnTop.description: Draw the labels of the background map over the areas and lines of the elements, instead of under them. The labels of markers are always on top.

StateLabels.description: How the labels are shown: those of markers, and those of the background map.

label.description: The text of the label next to the symbol; none if it is missing or "".

style.description: The symbol and the look of the label.

StateElementMarker.description: A symbol at a point, with an optional label.

Position.description: A position on the map: longitude and latitude, in degrees (WGS 84).

text.description: Plain text with simple formatting: **bold**, line breaks and links.

StatePopup.description: A popup that opens when the element is clicked or tapped in the viewer.

smooth.description: Drawn as a smooth curve through the points, instead of straight from point to point.

style.description: The line: its color, width and dashes, and the arrowheads.

smooth.description: Drawn as a smooth curve through the points, instead of straight from point to point.

style.description: The area: its color (with its opacity) and pattern.

strokeStyle.description: The outline: whether it is drawn, its color, width and dashes.

StateElementPolygon.description: An area within points; the last point connects to the first one.

style.description: The area: its color (with its opacity) and pattern.

strokeStyle.description: The outline: whether it is drawn, its color, width and dashes.
